claims.text: The final root cause of the payment-service duplicate-request backlog was a mismatch between the retry configuration and the timeout budget, confirmed at 10:00 +08:00.

supports.quote: Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests.
10:00 the final postmortem confirmed retry configuration and timeout budget mismatch.

claims.text: An earlier hypothesis that cache invalidation caused the incident was withdrawn at 09:15; it was not the final confirmed cause.

supports.quote: 09:00 cache invalidation was an early hypothesis. 09:15 the cache hypothesis was withdrawn.

claims.text: The payment-service incident is tracked by PAY-101, with final postmortem and runbook references, and the runbook directs inspection of the timeout budget and following the approved failover procedure.

supports.quote: PAY-101 tracks the payment-service incident. See the final postmortem and the current runbook.
Runbook v1: inspect the payment-service timeout budget and follow the approved failover procedure.
